description: Open-source programs compiled here for study 3 (ADR 0024). Role "study" and "pilot" are the programs of the study and its pilot; "calibration" marks the well-known programs of pilots 1 to 3, which the model already knew from memory. node scripts/setup.mjs --manifest sources.json downloads each source archive into tools/sources/, verifies its size and SHA-256 and extracts it. Source text only: no third-party executable is downloaded. challenges/real.mjs builds the targets from the extracted folders.
